一九七〇年十二月一日，星期二。

晚上七点，医疗系学员队党支部召开支部大会，讨论王建新的入党申请。

地点在教学楼二层的一间教室里。教室不大，能坐三四十人，平时上小课用的。黑板上方挂着伟人像，正中央是一面党旗，红色的，镰刀锤头，在灯光下格外醒目。桌椅摆得整整齐齐，第一排坐着支部的正式党员和预备党员，后面几排空着。

王建新到得早，六点半就来了。他坐在后排的椅子上，手里攥着那份入党志愿书，手指把纸边都捏皱了。他把志愿书放在桌上，又拿起来，又放下。心里不紧张是假的，但也不是那种害怕的紧张，而是一种说不清的感觉——像站在手术台前，拿起手术刀的那一刻。

陆陆续续地，党员们来了。教导员进来的时候朝他点了点头，坐到了前排。郑书记最后进来，手里拿着一个文件夹，走上讲台，把文件夹放在桌上，扫了一眼台下。

支部共有正式党员十二人、预备党员四人。应到正式党员十二人，实到十一人，一人因公出差，符合开会条件。

郑书记扶了扶眼镜，清了清嗓子，宣布开会。

“同志们，今天支部大会的主要议题是讨论王建新同志的入党申请。”他的声音不高，但很稳，“下面请王建新同志宣读入党志愿书。”

王建新站起来，走到讲台前。他转过身，面对着台下。台下坐着十一张面孔，有的熟悉，有的不太熟悉。教导员坐在第一排，看着他，眼神里带着鼓励。

他翻开那份入党志愿书，上面是他一笔一划写下的字迹。钢笔字，工工整整，没有涂改。他深吸了一口气，开始念。

“我自愿加入中国共产党，拥护党的纲领，遵守党的章程，履行党员义务，执行党的决定，严守党的纪律，保守党的秘密，对党忠诚，积极工作，为共产主义奋斗终身，随时准备为党和人民牺牲一切，永不叛党。”

念到“牺牲一切”的时候，他的声音不自觉地重了一些。

念完之后，他向支部大会汇报了自己的经历。声音不大，但每个字都清清楚楚。他讲自己出生在北京一个普通工人家庭，讲中学毕业后响应伟人号召上山下乡，到达茂旗插队。讲在牧场工作生活了三个月后被选派为民兵队员，执行巡边任务。讲在边境执勤时英勇作战，荣立一等功，被特招入伍，保送至北京医学院学习，成为一名工农兵学员。讲在双桥公社开门办学期间为当地群众治病，开展医疗工作。讲回到学校后完成了断指再植手术。

“我之所以申请加入中国共产党，是因为我深深认识到，没有共产党就没有新中国，就没有我个人的今天。”他看着台下的同志们，目光从一张张脸上扫过，“我在达茂旗边防部队服役时，亲眼看到共产党员在危险面前冲在最前面，在困难面前不低头。我渴望成为他们中的一员，为党和人民贡献自己的一切。”

汇报完毕，他回到座位上。

郑书记说：“下面请王建新同志的第二入党介绍人发言。”

教导员站起来，先宣读了外调函的内容。他从文件夹里抽出两张纸，念了边防团回函的主要内容，念了街道回函的主要内容。念完了，把纸放下，开始说话。

“我和王建新同志认识虽然只有几个月，但我对他的了解很深。”教导员的声音不高，但很诚恳，“这个同志政治觉悟高、思想品德好、工作能力强、作风扎实。在双桥公社开门办学期间，他带领医疗队为群众办了很多实事，受到当地群众的高度评价。回到学校后，他又出色地完成了断指再植手术，为学校和医疗系争了光。”

他顿了顿，又说：“我认为王建新同志符合党员条件，我愿意介绍他加入中国共产党。”

郑书记又拿起一张信纸，展开来，说：“张团长作为第一入党介绍人，因本职工作不能到达现场，他也写了一封信，现在我来为大家读一下。”

信纸是普通的信纸，叠了两折，上面是钢笔写的字，字迹歪歪扭扭的，但一笔一划写得很用力。

Tuesday, December 1, 1970.

At 7 o'clock in the evening, the Party branch of the medical student team held a branch meeting to discuss Wang Jianxin's application for party membership.

The location is in a classroom on the second floor of the teaching building.The classroom is not big, it can seat thirty or forty people, and is usually used for small classes.There are portraits of great figures hanging above the blackboard, and in the center is a party flag, red with a sickle and hammer head, which is particularly eye-catching under the light.The tables and chairs were arranged neatly, with the formal party members and probationary members of the branch sitting in the first row, and the following rows were empty.

Wang Jianxin arrived early, at half past six.He sat on the chair in the back row, holding the party application form in his hand, and the edges of the paper were wrinkled with his fingers.He put the volunteer book on the table, picked it up, and put it down again.It was fake that I wasn't nervous, but it wasn't the nervousness of fear, but an indescribable feeling - like the moment I stood in front of the operating table and picked up the scalpel.

One after another, party members came.The instructor nodded to him when he came in and sat in the front row.Secretary Zheng came in last, holding a folder in his hand, walked up to the podium, put the folder on the table, and glanced at the audience.

The branch has a total of 12 formal party members and four probationary members.Twelve official party members were supposed to be present, but actually eleven were present. One of them was on a business trip and met the meeting conditions.

Secretary Zheng adjusted his glasses, cleared his throat, and announced the meeting.

"Comrades, the main topic of today's branch meeting is to discuss Comrade Wang Jianxin's application for party membership." His voice was low but steady. "Now, I would like to ask Comrade Wang Jianxin to read out his application for joining the party."

Wang Jianxin stood up and walked to the podium.He turned around and faced the audience.There were eleven faces sitting under the stage, some familiar, some not so familiar.The instructor sat in the front row and looked at him with encouragement in his eyes.

He opened the application form for joining the party and saw his handwriting written on it.The pen writing is neat and neat, without any alteration.He took a deep breath and began to read.

"I voluntarily join the Communist Party of China, support the party's program, abide by the party's charter, fulfill the obligations of a party member, implement the party's decisions, strictly abide by the party's disciplines, the secrets of the conservative party, be loyal to the party, work actively, fight for communism throughout my life, be ready to sacrifice everything for the party and the people, and will never betray the party."

When he read "Sacrifice everything", his voice unconsciously became louder.

After reading it, he reported his experience to the branch meeting.The voice was not loud, but every word was clear.He said that he was born in an ordinary working-class family in Beijing. After graduating from high school, he responded to the great man's call to go to the mountains and countryside, and arrived in Maoqi to join the queue.After working and living in the ranch for three months, he was selected as a member of the militia to perform border patrol duties.He fought bravely while on duty at the border, won first-class merit, was specially recruited into the army, and was recommended to study at Beijing Medical College, where he became a worker, peasant, and soldier student.Talk about treating local people and carrying out medical work during the period when Shuangqiao Commune is open for school.After returning to school, he completed the replantation surgery of his severed finger.

"The reason why I applied to join the Communist Party of China is because I deeply realize that without the Communist Party, there would be no New China, and I would not be where I am today." He looked at the comrades in the audience, his eyes sweeping across the faces. "When I served in the Damao Banner Border Guard Force, I saw with my own eyes that Communists rushed to the front in the face of danger and did not bow in the face of difficulties. I am eager to become one of them and contribute everything I have to the party and the people."

After the report, he returned to his seat.

Secretary Zheng said: “Now I’d like to invite Comrade Wang Jianxin’s second party introducer to speak.”

The instructor stood up and read out the contents of the transfer letter first.He took out two pieces of paper from the folder and read out the main content of the response letter from the border guard regiment and the main content of the reply letter from the street.After reading, put down the paper and start talking.

"Although Comrade Wang Jianxin and I have only known each other for a few months, I have a deep understanding of him." The instructor's voice was low but sincere. "This comrade has high political awareness, good ideological and moral character, strong work ability, and a solid style. When Shuangqiao Commune was open for school, he led the medical team to do many practical things for the masses and was highly praised by the local people. After returning to school, he successfully completed the replantation of a severed finger, which brought glory to the school and the medical department."

He paused and then said: "I think Comrade Wang Jianxin meets the requirements for party membership, and I am willing to introduce him to join the Communist Party of China."

Secretary Zheng picked up another piece of letter paper, unfolded it, and said: "As the first introducer of party membership, Captain Zhang could not arrive at the scene due to his own work. He also wrote a letter. Now I will read it for you."

The letter paper is an ordinary letter paper, folded in two, with pen writing on it. The handwriting is crooked, but the writing is very vigorous.
